title: ₹3,000 MRI Scan: How Many Scans Pay for a ₹3 Crore Machine?
description: No scraped reels this week, so this is reasoning. The ICU bed and blood test reels show the audience likes hospital-adjacent insider economics. A machine-capex break-even reel has a clear number to chase, and diagnostic centres feel high-status but are opaque to outsiders.
text:
HISAAB FACT SHEET: ECONOMICS OF AN MRI/CT DIAGNOSTIC IMAGING CENTRE (INDIA)
Prepared 9 Nov 2026.

**READ THIS FIRST (for the scriptwriter)**
- I found no audited payback for a private Indian MRI centre. Payback figures below come from a government-hospital study, a project-report consultant and an equipment vendor.
- Many machine and AMC prices come from equipment sellers' blogs. They conflict with each other, so I give ranges and name the source.
- I did not calculate any numbers myself. Do the on-screen maths only from the cited inputs, and label it "illustrative".
- The hook's "₹3 crore machine" fits the market. See the machine prices below. Some sellers quote ₹2–3 crore for 1.5T, so "₹3 crore" is a fair mid-point to use.

**1. MACHINE COST (what you pay before the first scan)**
- 1.5T MRI, new: ₹4 crore–₹7 crore+. [https://sashahealthcare.com/1-5t-mri-machine-cost-2026-price-guide/]
- 1.5T MRI, refurbished: ₹1.5 crore–₹3.5 crore+. [https://sashahealthcare.com/1-5t-mri-machine-cost-2026-price-guide/]
- 1.5T MRI, pre-owned: ₹80 lakh–₹2 crore+, depending on condition. [https://sashahealthcare.com/1-5t-mri-machine-cost-2026-price-guide/]
- Another seller's range for a new 1.5T is ₹5 crore–₹10 crore or more. [https://sashahealthcare.com/mri-machine-prices-in-india-the-complete-2026-guide-to-new-refurbished-mri-costs/]
- Delhi seller: a new 1.5T costs ₹6 crore–₹10 crore, and a new 3T costs ₹14 crore–₹25 crore. [https://www.arnicahealthtech.com/cities/mri-machine-cost-in-delhi]
- Delhi seller: a refurbished 1.5T costs ₹1.5 crore–₹4 crore. [https://www.arnicahealthtech.com/cities/mri-machine-cost-in-delhi]
- Another seller puts 3T at ₹5 crore–₹8 crore. It also says 1.5T is enough for 90% of routine diagnostics. [https://sashahealthcare.com/how-much-does-an-mri-machine-cost-in-india/]
- Compare that with Siemens 3T at ₹8 crore–₹15 crore. [https://sashahealthcare.com/siemens-mri-machine-price-in-india-1-5t-3t-models-cost/]
- 3T prices vary a lot between sellers, so avoid one fixed number on screen.
- Per a Mar 2026 report, MRI system prices typically fall between ₹5 crore and ₹15 crore. [https://theprint.in/health/west-asia-war-no-mri-blackout-from-helium-crisis-but-cost-pressure-likely-for-new-ageing-scanners/2896457/]
- A helium price spike was estimated to push installation costs up 3–7%. [https://theprint.in/health/west-asia-war-no-mri-blackout-from-helium-crisis-but-cost-pressure-likely-for-new-ageing-scanners/2896457/]
- Machine price is not the whole bill. Installation is estimated at ₹60 lakh–₹1.5 crore. [https://sashahealthcare.com/how-much-does-an-mri-machine-cost-in-india/]
- Delhi seller's installation figure is ₹30 lakh–₹80 lakh on top of the machine. [https://www.arnicahealthtech.com/cities/mri-machine-cost-in-delhi]
- RF shielding room: ₹25 lakh–₹50 lakh. [https://sashahealthcare.com/how-much-does-an-mri-machine-cost-in-india/]
- A different seller says RF shielding is ₹15 lakh–₹30 lakh and civil work is ₹5 lakh–₹15 lakh. [https://sashahealthcare.com/mri-machine-price-in-india-2026-refurbished-1-5t-3t-cost/]
- Room size: a 1.5T MRI needs about 500–700 sq ft. [https://sashahealthcare.com/mri-machine-price-in-india-2026-refurbished-1-5t-3t-cost/]
- Site preparation and shielding are estimated at 10–20% of equipment cost. [https://flabslis.com/blogs/mri-machine-price-in-india]

**2. WHOLE-CENTRE SETUP COST**
- MRI diagnostic centre (2,500–3,500 sq ft, 1.5T MRI plus supporting imaging/lab): capex ₹4 crore–₹8 crore. Working capital is ₹40 lakh–₹80 lakh. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- CT-only centre (16–64 slice CT plus basic imaging/lab): capex ₹2.5 crore–₹4.5 crore. Working capital is ₹30 lakh–₹60 lakh. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- Full pathology + X-ray + USG + CT + MRI centre: ₹6 crore–₹10+ crore. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- Equipment is 50–70% of total setup cost. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- Refurbished 16–32 slice CT: ₹35 lakh–₹60 lakh for the machine, ₹1.5 crore–₹2.5 crore installed. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- New 32–64 slice CT: ₹2.5 crore–₹4 crore+. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- Licensing and consultancy: roughly ₹3 lakh–₹5 lakh. Keep at least 6 months of working capital. [https://www.coveryou.in/blog/building-a-highly-profitable-diagnostic-imaging-centre-in-india/]
- Approvals needed: AERB, PNDT registration, Clinical Establishments Act, biomedical waste management, fire NOC, GST and municipal permissions. [https://projectreportbank.com/diagnostic-centre-project-cost-india/]
- AERB licence is mandatory to run CT equipment. [https://kiranpetct.com/the-ct-scan-cost-in-bangalore/]

**3. RUNNING COSTS**
- AMC (annual maintenance contract) quotes vary widely:
  - ₹8 lakh–₹20 lakh a year. [https://sashahealthcare.com/mri-machine-price-in-india-2026-refurbished-1-5t-3t-cost/]
  - ₹15 lakh–₹30 lakh a year. [https://flabslis.com/blogs/mri-machine-price-in-india]
  - ₹15 lakh–₹40 lakh a year. [https://sashahealthcare.com/what-is-the-cost-of-an-mri-machine-complete-2026-price-guide/]
  - 8–10% of machine value. [https://sashahealthcare.com/how-much-does-an-mri-machine-cost-in-india/]
- AMC for specific Siemens models:
  - Magnetom Essenza/Symphony: ₹8 lakh–₹10 lakh a year.
  - Avanto: ₹10 lakh–₹12 lakh a year.
  - Aera/Skyra: ₹12 lakh–₹15 lakh a year. [https://sunraysmedical.com/newsroom/siemens-mri-amc-vs-cmc-cost-analysis-india]
- A basic AMC does not cover spare parts, major component replacement or helium. [https://sunraysmedical.com/newsroom/siemens-mri-amc-vs-cmc-cost-analysis-india]
- Another vendor says OEM service for a 1.5T is ₹50 lakh–₹1.5 crore a year. It says third-party service is ₹30 lakh–₹90 lakh a year, a 30–40% saving. [https://www.elesonicgroup.com/services/mri-machine-price-india]
- Treat this as a vendor claim. There is a big gap between the cheapest and costliest AMC, so say "varies by brand and contract".
- Electricity: ₹1.5 lakh–₹3 lakh a month. Helium: ₹5 lakh–₹15 lakh a year. Total running cost is ₹20 lakh–₹50 lakh a year. That total looks low next to the other AMC and staff figures, so treat it as a vendor estimate. [https://sashahealthcare.com/what-is-the-cost-of-an-mri-machine-complete-2026-price-guide/]
- Government hospital study: electricity worked out to ₹312 per scan, at ₹15,47,254 a year. [https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7546299/]
- A helium refill used to cost around ₹25 lakh and can now run ₹35 lakh or more. Most installed MRI machines now use technology needing almost no routine refills. [https://theprint.in/health/west-asia-war-no-mri-blackout-from-helium-crisis-but-cost-pressure-likely-for-new-ageing-scanners/2896457/]
- Older magnets (1997–2005) lose about 1–3% of their helium each month. [https://theprint.in/health/west-asia-war-no-mri-blackout-from-helium-crisis-but-cost-pressure-likely-for-new-ageing-scanners/2896457/]
- Staff costs:
  - MRI technician: ₹3.5 lakh–₹4.2 lakh a year, about ₹23,000–₹28,000 a month. [https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/gfg-academy/radiologic-technologist-salary-in-india/]
  - Another source says radiologic technologists earn ₹3.5 lakh–₹5 lakh a year. [https://blogs.docthub.com/high-paying-cities-for-radiology-salary-in-india-where-to-earn-more-BLG470
